title: PersistedStateHeader
description: Header for all persisted CRP data structures (cold state, event log, exported state). Enables schema migration across versions.

schema_version.description: SemVer for the persisted format (e.g., '2.0.0'). Implementations MUST read state from the same Major version.

protocol_version.description: CRP protocol version that wrote this state.

created_at.description: Timestamp of state creation (seconds since epoch).

checksum.description: BLAKE3 integrity hash of the payload. If verification fails, implementations MUST raise StateCorrupted (code 1030).
